name: tether-browser

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List the browser tabs you can use. Normally these are the tabs the user shared by clicking Tether, plus tabs you or those pages opened. If the user has turned on bypass mode, every tab is listed.

tools.name: open_tab
tools.description: Open a URL in a new tab in the user's browser. The new tab is shared with you.

browser.description: Browser key from list_tabs when several browsers are connected.

opener.description: Shared tab to open next to.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a shared tab.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Go to a URL in a shared tab, or go back, forward or reload.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Read the page as an outline of headings, text and interactive elements. Each element you can act on has a ref like [e14]. Take a snapshot before acting and use the refs in click, type and fill_form.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Get the visible text of the page, or of one element, as plain text. Good for reading articles, tables and results.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e14".

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e14".

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Move the pointer over an element, e.g. to open a menu.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e14".

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type into a text field or editable area. Replaces the current value unless append is true.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e14".

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill several fields at once. Text fields take a string, checkboxes and radios take true or false, selects take the option label or value.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e14".

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Choose one or more options in a select element, by label or value.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e14".

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key, optionally on an element. Examples: "Enter", "Escape", "Tab", "ArrowDown", "Control+a".

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e14".

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll an element into view, or scroll the page by a number of pixels.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e14".

dy.description: Pixels down (negative scrolls up). Default one screen.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until some text appears or disappears, or for a number of milliseconds.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

gone.description: Wait for the text to disappear instead.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the visible part of a shared tab. The tab is brought to the front first.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: run_js
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the page's own context (page globals are visible) and return the result of the last expression, awaited if it is a promise. Works on sites with a strict CSP. Use for reading data the outline does not show or driving page APIs directly.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Attach local files to a file input, as if the user picked them.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e14".

tools.name: save_watcher
tools.description: Watch a page and notify the user when something they care about happens ("tell me when the price drops below 2000", "when results are posted"). The browser fetches the page on a schedule with the user's cookies. mode=fetch (default) loads the URL without rendering it, so point it at the JSON API you found with network_requests when there is one; check is a function body that receives response = { status, url, text, json, contentType } and has no DOM. mode=tab opens the page in a background tab for a moment, for pages built by JavaScript; check runs in the page with full DOM access. check either returns a value (the user is notified when it changes from the last run) or { notify: true/false, message, value }. Notifications go to a browser notification and, with notify including "ntfy", to the user's ntfy topic. Test with run_watcher.

check.description: JavaScript function body. Return a value, or { notify, message, value }.

tools.name: list_watchers
tools.description: List watchers with their last result.

tools.name: run_watcher
tools.description: Run a watcher now and return what its check produced. Set notify to true to send the notification if it fires; by default this is a dry run that still records the value as the new baseline.

tools.name: delete_watcher
tools.description: Delete a watcher.

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: List the media on a shared tab: images, video and audio (with size, length, playing state), canvases and CSS background images, plus HLS/DASH streams and media files the page loaded (from the network log). Each has an id like m3 for save_media. Streams only appear after the page has requested them, so start playback first.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: save_media
tools.description: Save an item from list_media (or any URL) to disk under ~/.tether/media/<site>/, using the browser's cookies. Handles normal files, blob: and data: URLs, canvases, and HLS/DASH streams (through ffmpeg). Returns the file path.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: video_frame
tools.description: Get the current frame of a video on a shared tab as an image. Falls back to a cropped screenshot when the site doesn't allow reading the video.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

ref.description: The video's ref from list_media or snapshot.

tools.name: wait_for_download
tools.description: After clicking something that downloads a file (an invoice, a CSV export, a PDF), wait for it to finish and get its path on disk. Downloads that started in the last 15 seconds count, so call it right after the click.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a URL through the user's browser, with their cookies, and get the saved file's path. Limited to sites of shared tabs unless bypass mode is on.

filename.description: File name inside the browser's download folder.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: list_downloads
tools.description: List files downloaded while tabs were shared with you (not the user's whole download history).

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: wait_for_user
tools.description: Hand a shared tab to the user and wait for them. With message, the page shows it with a Done button and brings the tab to the front: use it for CAPTCHAs, 2FA codes, logins, payment confirmation or any choice that is theirs. Without message, it waits for the user to resume a tab they paused (actions on a paused tab fail with a note saying so). Returns when they press Done or Resume, or after the timeout.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

message.description: What the user should do, in one or two sentences.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start working in the user's own browser (their logins and cookies) when no tab is shared yet. mode=window (default) opens a separate window for you, so the user's tabs are left alone; every tab you open in it is yours. mode=current asks to use the tab the user is looking at, for tasks about the page they're on. The user approves in a prompt (up to two minutes). Returns the tab handle and a snapshot.

url.description: For mode=window: the page to open first.

reason.description: One sentence the user will read, saying what you're about to do.

browser.description: Browser key when several are connected.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: Finish a session you started: closes the window start_session opened for you (all of them if you don't name one). With tab, stops using that shared tab instead, leaving it open for the user.

tab.description: Stop using this tab rather than closing your window.

tools.name: request_bypass
tools.description: Ask the user for bypass mode, which gives you every open tab in the browser instead of only the shared ones. The browser shows the user a prompt with your reason and waits up to two minutes for an answer. Only ask when the task needs other tabs.

reason.description: One sentence the user will read, saying why you need the other tabs.

tools.name: network_requests
tools.description: List network requests made by a shared tab since it was shared (newest last): id, method, status, type, time, size, URL. Use network_request with an id to see headers and bodies.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

filter.description: Substring of the URL, or an HTTP method.

type.description: xhr, fetch, document, script, stylesheet, image, media, font, websocket, other.

failedOnly.description: Only failed requests and HTTP errors.

clear.description: Clear the log instead of listing.

tools.name: network_request
tools.description: Show one captured request in full: request and response headers, request body and response body.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: console_messages
tools.description: Read console output and uncaught errors from a shared tab since it was shared.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: cookies
tools.description: List the cookies the browser would send to the tab's current page, including httpOnly ones.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: list_scripts
tools.description: List the user's userscripts: ones you saved and ones they imported. They live in ~/.tether/scripts as .user.js files, appear in the Tether popup on matching sites, and work unchanged in Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey.

tools.name: save_script
tools.description: Save a reusable userscript. `code` is the body of a function: plain JavaScript with full DOM access in the page, no imports; use `return` to hand a result back to run_script. These GM_ APIs work in Tether and in Tampermonkey: GM_addStyle, GM_getValue, GM_setValue, GM_deleteValue, GM_listValues, GM_xmlhttpRequest, GM_openInTab, GM_setClipboard, GM_notification, unsafeWindow. run=manual puts a Run button in the popup (and a menu command in Tampermonkey); run=auto runs on every matching page load. Saving an existing name replaces it and bumps its version.

tools.name: get_script
tools.description: Read a saved script, to change it. Returns the editable body for scripts you saved, or the whole file for imported ones.

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Run a saved script in a shared tab and return its result.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: install_userscript
tools.description: Install a userscript (.user.js) or user style (.user.css) from a URL, such as Greasy Fork, OpenUserJS or userstyles.world, or from pasted text. It is saved unchanged. @require'd libraries and style preprocessors (Stylus, Less) are not supported.

tools.name: get_requests
tools.description: Read change requests the user sent from the Tether popup: what they want changed on a site, often with reference images (screenshots, mockups, mood boards). The tab they sent it from is shared with you. Handle open requests, then call resolve_request.

tools.name: resolve_request
tools.description: Mark a change request done and leave a short reply the user sees in the popup (what you changed, and how to turn it off).

tools.name: apply_css
tools.description: Preview CSS on a shared tab without saving it. Each call replaces the previous preview on that tab; navigation clears it. Check the result with screenshot, then save_style.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: clear_preview
tools.description: Remove the CSS preview from a tab.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

tools.name: save_style
tools.description: Save CSS that restyles a site on every visit, in every connected browser. It is stored as a UserCSS file (~/.tether/styles/<id>.user.css) that also installs unchanged in Stylus. It shows in the popup on matching pages, where the user can switch it off. Saving an existing name replaces it and bumps its version. Use !important where the site's own rules win. For changes CSS can't do, pair it with save_script (run=auto).

tab.description: A shared tab the style applies to. Before and after screenshots of it go into the user's gallery.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: List saved site styles, yours and imported ones.

tools.name: get_style
tools.description: Read a saved style, to change it. Returns the editable CSS for styles you saved, or the whole UserCSS file for imported ones.

tools.name: delete_style
tools.description: Delete a saved style.

tools.name: site_list
tools.description: List sites Tether has recorded the user using (clicks, typing, pages, API calls), and sites with saved notes.

tools.name: site_map
tools.description: Summarise everything recorded for a site: its pages, the buttons and links the user actually uses on each (with CSS selectors), the fields they fill, the API endpoints behind it, common paths between pages, and saved notes. Pass page for one page in detail including its last outline. Read this before automating or restyling a site.

tools.name: site_sessions
tools.description: List recorded sessions for a site, or read one session's timeline step by step.

tools.name: site_notes
tools.description: Read or write notes about a site that persist for future sessions and other agents: how things work, where things are, gotchas. Without text it reads them.

append.description: Add to the notes instead of replacing them.

tools.name: delete_script
tools.description: Delete a saved script.

instructions: Tether gives you the user's real, logged-in browser tabs. Prefer it to a separate automated browser for anything the user would do in their own browser. You can only use tabs the user shared (and tabs those pages open), unless they approve bypass mode. Start with list_tabs; if nothing is shared, call start_session, which opens your own window in their browser after they approve. Then snapshot to read the page and get element refs. Act with click, type, fill_form; each action returns a fresh snapshot. Use network_requests and console_messages to debug. The user can send you change requests (text and images) from the Tether popup: read them with get_requests. To restyle a site, preview with apply_css, check with screenshot, then save_style; use save_script for behaviour. Before working on a site, site_map shows what Tether recorded about how the user uses it. Ask before submitting payments, sending messages or deleting anything. Call end_session when you are done with your window.
